description: I am always ready to answer all your questions. Schedule a consultation — I'm happy to help!

faq.question: How long does website development or video editing take?
faq.answer: The duration depends on the complexity and requirements of your project. Typically the process takes a few weeks to several months. For an exact timeframe I offer an initial consultation and estimate.

faq.question: Do you work with international clients?
faq.answer: Yes! I have extensive experience providing website development and video production services to international clients. Regardless of your location I am ready to deliver your project to the highest standards.

faq.question: How much does it cost to create a website or video?
faq.answer: The cost depends on your specific requirements and the complexity of the project. After an initial consultation I will give you an accurate cost estimate based on your needs and wishes.

faq.question: What happens if I order both services — website and video?
faq.answer: Ordering both services together is an excellent choice! For clients who order both website development and video services I offer special terms, discounts and comprehensive solutions. Let's discuss your project and I'll create the best result for you.
